mentions.name: SearchSpot.ai
mentions.description: Travel planning tool that treats trip planning as a decision-confidence problem rather than a search problem. It preserves trip context, compares travel options across constraints, keeps bucketlists and itinerary views, and shows transparent reasoning so users can eliminate options in a trustworthy, non-black-box way.
mentions.problem: Existing tools are good at giving links, filters, or generated itineraries, but not great at helping people rule out travel options in a way that feels trustworthy, forcing travelers to stitch together many scattered sources.
mentions.audience: Most people planning a real trip, who currently stitch together OTAs, maps, blogs, Reddit, Instagram, weather, commute times, and reviews.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're building SearchSpot.ai.
The basic idea is that travel planning is less a search problem and more a decision-confidence problem.
